messages:
Rita Alvarez: Quick kickoff 10 need a tight newsletter + webinar nurture for the benchmark launch. Goal: RSVPs + report downloads. Thinking 3 emails pre-event + 2 followups. Who owns segments + subject tests?
Ben Cho: I'll take segmentation. Propose 3 segments: customers (AE route), trials (convert focus), engaged newsletter (open >=2 in 60d). Keep cold suppressed.
Nina Park: Subject-line test plan: personalization vs data-led. Example A: "Rita, join our benchmark walkthrough"; B: "New benchmark: inference cost & latency numbers". Seed 10% then pick winner at 24h.
Jake Mills: ESP notes: we can only run 2 variants per send without separate sends. Also watch DKIM for campaign subdomain. Suppress anyone who downloaded report in last 30d and unsubscribed from product.
Ben Cho: Segment filters (CSV-ready): customers: tag:customer AND active_30d:true; trials: tag:trial AND event_14d:gte; engaged: opt_in:newsletter AND opens_60d:gte2.
Nina Park: Cadence: Invite (value + CTA), Reminder (agenda + speakers), Last-chance (social proof). Post-event: recording + TL;DR; highlights with download CTA. Use UTMs: utm_campaign=bench_launch_q2, utm_medium=email, utm_source=newsletter.
Jake Mills: QA checklist: seeds (support@, product@, 3 staff inboxes), test personalization tokens on 100 samples, verify List-Unsubscribe header, check image CDN, render tests Gmail/Outlook/Apple Mail. If seed spam rate >0.4% hold.
Rita Alvarez: Ops Bot 1 create campaign skeleton and assign: segments (Ben), subject tests (Nina), ESP QA (Jake). Dry-run 4 days before send.
Ops Bot: Campaign created: "Benchmark Launch 1 Mini Nurture". Tasks assigned with due dates. Dry-run scheduled.
Ben Cho: Send windows: customers Tue 10am PT, trials Wed 11am PT, engaged Thu 8am PT (split if >15k). Throttle batches >20k.
Nina Park: For engaged cohort run 10/90 subject seed then winner. For customers/trials prefer personalized subject only. For engaged avoid heavy images.
Rita Alvarez: I'll drop invite + reminder copy in the doc by EOD. Thanks team :rocket:
